title: Organic photosensitizers: from molecular design to phototheranostics
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,8406-8433
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00599J, Review Article
Tian Zhang, Xinyu Qu, Jinjun Shao, Xiaochen Dong
Photodynamic therapy (PDT) has emerged as a highly promising approach for tumor treatment, this review discusses molecular engineering strategies through rational structure design, focusing on five critical aspects.
